record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.original_question: For the periodic initial value problem for the Korteweg-de Vries equation, u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0 with x ∈ T, t ∈ R, and initial data u(x,0)=φ(x), determine whether the problem is well-posed in H^s(T) for some s < -1. The paper notes well-posedness for s ≥ -1, and says the lower-regularity regime below -1 remains open.

evidence.quote: Whether the IVP (4.20) is well-posed in the space H s (R) for any s < − 34 or the IVP (4.21) is well-posed in the space H s (T) for any s < −1 is still an open question.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the periodic initial value problem for the Korteweg–de Vries equation
  u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0,   x ∈ T = R/2πZ,  t ∈ R,
  u(x, 0) = φ(x),
where φ ∈ H^s(T) for some s ∈ R. Recall that the problem is said to be (locally) well-posed in H^s(T) if, for every initial datum φ ∈ H^s(T), there exist a time T = T(‖φ‖_{H^s}) > 0 and a unique solution u ∈ C([0,T]; H^s(T)) such that the data-to-solution map φ ↦ u is continuous from H^s(T) into C([0,T]; H^s(T)).

It is known that the problem is well-posed in H^s(T) for every s ≥ −1. Determine whether there exists any s < −1 for which the periodic KdV initial value problem is well-posed in H^s(T).
artifact.status_search_result: Molinet (Sharp ill-posedness results for the KdV and mKdV equations on the torus, Adv. Math. 2012, arXiv:1105.3601) proved that the KdV solution map cannot be continuously extended from H^s(T) to the space of distributions for any s < −1, establishing sharp ill-posedness below H^{-1}. Combined with the well-posedness in H^{-1}(T) by Kappeler–Topalov (later reproved by Killip–Vișan in Annals of Math. 2019), this shows H^{-1} is the sharp threshold and answers the question in the negative: periodic KdV is not well-posed in H^s(T) for any s < −1.

status_evidence.title: Sharp ill-posedness results for the KdV and mKdV equations on the torus
status_evidence.snippet: The solution-maps associated with the mKdV and the KdV equations are discontinuous for the H^s(T) topology for s<0 and s<-1 respectively, and these results are sharp.
status_evidence.claim: Periodic KdV is ill-posed in H^s(T) for every s < -1.

status_evidence.title: KdV is well-posed in H^{-1} (Killip–Vișan)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove global well-posedness of the Korteweg–de Vries equation in H^{-1}(R) and H^{-1}(T).
status_evidence.claim: H^{-1}(T) is attainable, making s=-1 the sharp threshold.
